items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What's Pal, uh, Palette Lane? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Palette Lane, right back, you go back to Seminole Avenue...

ctx.x: Yeah, cataract on his eyes. Yeah, he played with a better call for you. Yeah.
What's Pal, uh, Palette Lane? What's Palette Lane? The Pilot Lane, however you want to say it. Pilot Lane?
Where's Pilot Lane? Yeah. Oh, Palette Lane, right back, you go back to Seminole Avenue, until it run out, Seminole Avenue runs out. And then, uh, all around Searach, uh, to Murrayview Avenue.
